reviews.text: Very good very hydration. Better for colder seasons. But not so good for acne prone skin because of formulation. But in a winter time it is good in night routine
reviews.zh: 非常好，非常保濕。啱啱涼啲嘅季節。不過因為配方關係，對暗瘡肌就唔算太好。但係冬天嗰陣用喺晚間護膚程序就唔錯。

reviews.text: Great face cream! It feels lightweight on the skin but still provides excellent hydration. The texture is smooth, absorbs nicely, and leaves the skin soft and glowing. It works well under makeup and doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. Overall, a really good product that I enjoy using daily.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅面霜！搽上皮膚感覺輕盈但係保濕力一流。質地滑順，吸收得好，皮膚會變得柔軟有光澤。搽咗妝前打底都好夾，唔會厚重亦唔會油笠。整體嚟講真係一款好好用嘅產品，我每日都好享受用佢。

reviews.text: Obsessed with this moisturizer. It is now a staple in my routine. It is think and lush and my skin drinks it up. I wake up in the morning and my face feels plump and well hydrated.
reviews.zh: 我已經迷上咗呢款保濕霜。依家已經係我護膚程序必備嘅一員。質地厚身又豐盈，皮膚即刻飲晒佢。朝早起身塊面感覺飽滿又保濕。

reviews.text: This cream is wonderful—it absorbs beautifully into the skin without pilling under other products. It’s neither sticky nor greasy, and leaves my skin looking deeply hydrated. After trying two samples from another set, I purchased the full size. I love that it doesn’t irritate or clog my skin. I will definitely repurchase this in the future.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜真係好正——佢吸收得好好，搽完再疊其他產品都唔會搓泥。唔會黏笠亦唔會油笠，皮膚望落去深層保濕嘅感覺。用咗另一套嘅兩包試用裝之後，我就買咗正裝。好鍾意佢唔會刺激皮膚又唔會堵塞毛孔。日後一定會回購。

reviews.text: Smells really gross but man does this work so well. it is super rich and hydrating I use as a night cream only when its hot out and as a day cream also in dry cold months.
reviews.zh: 聞落真係好難聞，但係佢真係超有效果。質地超級滋潤又保濕，我喺熱嘅時候淨係當晚霜用，喺又乾又凍嘅月份就日霜晚霜都會用。

reviews.text: The cream is thick but once it is applied, it makes your skin look filtered. I loved the feel of it also. Super bummed it’s out of stock at the moment. But I would definitely reorder!
reviews.zh: 面霜比較厚身，但係一搽上面，成塊面就好似開咗濾鏡咁。觸感我都好鍾意。依家冇貨真係超級失望。但係我一定會再落單！

reviews.text: I love this brand I used all the skin care excellent products but specially the ceramic cream is amazing, not greasy, real glow and good hydration.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個品牌，佢哋嘅護膚品全部都好出色，但係 ceramic cream 特別勁，唔會油笠，有真正嘅光澤同埋好好嘅保濕。

reviews.text: Sinceramente no esperaba nada de esta crema y me sorprendió. Esta crema venía de regalo en un paquete que compré con el tóner, y al principio no le vi mucha diferencia pero después empecé a ver que en realidad si había una diferencia muy grande cuando la utilizaba con mi maquillaje, mi piel se ve tan radiante y nutrida, me da ese glow que necesito, me encanto así que decidí pedirla en su versión grande. Con muy poquito es suficiente, le hidrata muy bien, aunque siento que tal vez una piel grasa puede ser un poco pesada.
reviews.zh: 講真我本來對呢款面霜冇咩期望，但係佢畀到我驚喜。呢款面霜係我買 toner 嗰個 package 入面附送嘅，一開始我覺得冇乜分別，但係之後就發現用佢配搭化妝真係差好遠，皮膚望落去好有光澤又飽滿，畀到我想要嘅嗰種 glow，我好鍾意所以就決定買大裝。只需要好少份量就夠，保濕力好好，不過我覺得油性肌用嘅話可能會有少少厚重。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
